production_delta.M07-A.1: _LaunchAggregate keeps a durable ownership history of the channel (_channel_owns_raw, _channel_owned_raw) that is written at the actual registration of the channel and is never revoked; the eligibility of a raw close is decided with the history and not with the presence of the channel in the active slot; _release_raw_streams refuses the raw close of an original that the channel took.
production_delta.M07-A.2: _LaunchAggregate._register_pending_raw registers the original identities of the process with the owner before the first interruptible raw step; _release_launch_process exports every ordinary failure as it happens (retained_out) and writes the failures into the shared dictionary of the owner (failures_out); _LaunchAggregate._reconcile_pending_raw keeps every unresolved original - failed or never visited - with its identity and its owner.
production_delta.M07-A.3: _release_minimum returns the current minimum of a release together with the clock of its domain; _release_launch_process asks it before every initial raw close and refuses a new close when the bound arrived; _release_budget reads the minimum through it.
production_delta.M08: no path of M08 was altered: the delta of this follow-up touches the ownership of the original resources of a launch and the admission of their closes.

test_drivers.PF13-01: N07-R09 (the completed channel with the failing original HANDLE and the same-owner retry), N05-R10 (the ordinary failure followed by the exact cancellation, the companion with the cancellation at the first raw close, and the cross-product with the earlier success and the failing HANDLE) and N10-R05 (the round tightened during the wait and between two initial closes, the positive case and the already-owned retry).
test_drivers.PF13-02: N07-R02: the millisecond boundary with a common zero clock origin through the API adapter, the recovery adapter and the Core adapter; the expected values are derived from the actual remaining.
test_drivers.PF13-03: N10-R07 (the real parent pump through the BrokerProcess and the queue of the channel, and the parent reply event, with the zero expiry) and N07-R13 (the public Session.stop while the process of the round is admitted, with the counters of the read, of the digest and of the constructor of the channel).
